limitations: Actual cloud appearance and animation unverified

wind.interpolation: Linear continuous ramps with matching loop endpoints; deterministic authored variability, not random weather.
wind.runtimeMechanism: Saved native LevelSequence autoplay loops indefinitely. Actor/component possessable binding drives Strength and Speed. No Python runtime ticker or editor-only playback callback.
wind.inputPreservation: No camera tracks/cuts, no movement/look input suppression.
wind.criticalConsumerLimit: WindDirectionalSource documentation and installed header say only SpeedTree assets. Generic context vegetation and cloth do not automatically respond. Existing trees are preserved, no Mount trees added. Wind response and actor setters must be sampled in PIE before claiming visible motion.
